public/channel-switcher.js.reason: Routing-only shell API for the shared native-component Updates tab; same preference key, confirmation and navigation semantics. Requires independent content review.

electron/build.mjs.reason: CSP hashes cover both app shells; no native storage format change.

package.json.reason: Build/check commands only; dependency declarations and stored formats unchanged.

src/components/sidebarLeft/tabs/phantomc.reason: Presentation-only Updates tab using Row, RadioField, RadioForm and SettingSection. One Release channel radio now drives both surfaces: it calls the routing-only shell (window.phantomchatChannels) and the Electron update bridge (setUpdateChannel). The two channel-choice helpers it uses moved to lib/phantomchat/update-channel-choice.ts so the copy also resolves in pinned Stable. No database access, no storage format change; the tab only reads and writes the two existing channel preferences. Copied to pinned Stable by the builder. Explicit Stable/Preview accessible names exclude the enclosing Row subtitle; no channel or persistence semantics change. Explicit radio subtitles are attached with aria-describedby (not aria-label) so the accessible name stays exact while the Row explanation is still announced; no behaviour, storage or IPC change. Preview hash refreshed for that presentation-only change.

src/helpers/themeController.ts.reason: Restore original Stable UI colours; reverse prior stock Preview palette at render time only, preserving custom settings and persisted data. Independent review remains required.

src/helpers/understatedTheme.ts.reason: Restore original Stable UI colours; reverse prior stock Preview palette at render time only, preserving custom settings and persisted data. Independent review remains required.

src/components/sidebarLeft/foldersSideba.reason: Sets glyph "#" for Code in the rail payload. Presentation only.
getIconForFilter returns a placeholder icon key for Code because the glyph overrides it. Presentation only.

src/components/sidebarLeft/tabs/editFold.reason: Comment-only: records that this tab is unreachable by decision (folders are code-defined) so the dead delete-folder path is not read as live UI. The icon picker it still carries uses the existing dialogFilter.emoticon schema field, copied through opaquely by old channels; no migration, no schema change.

src/config/state.ts.reason: Adds optional StateSettings.defaultChatFolderId. Optional key in the settings object: old channels preserve unknown keys opaquely and ignore them; no reset or migration on load.

src/helpers/dom/createFolderContextMenu..reason: Menu only: drops the 'Edit folders' entry (folders are code-defined). Set/Remove default and Mark all as read untouched.

src/lang.ts.reason: Two new display strings: 'Disable Sidebar' and 'Enable Sidebar'. No storage or behaviour change.

src/lib/appDialogsManager.ts.reason: Session chip on dialog rows only: appends the `#` badge element beside the existing P2P badge. No data, storage or protocol touch; the chip hides itself for every non-session peer.

src/lib/folders-default.ts.reason: New pure module: startup-folder decision helpers and launch-hash capture. No I/O, no storage access.

src/scripts/out/langPack.strings.reason: Generated lang-pack mirror of the two new label keys. Text only.

src/components/addToFolderDropdownMenu/h.reason: Display-only: add-to-folder menu icon now consults the picked folder emoticon first (pick > title emoji/docId > built-in). Reads an optional filter field; no storage format change.

src/lib/phantomchat/phantomchat-launch-d.reason: Launch preview refresh also reads the Groups (3) folder so group conversations get their cached previews reloaded. Read-only over existing dialog data.

src/components/sidebarLeft/index.ts.reason: The chat-list + button opens the single-contact picker (and creates a session group from the pick) when the active folder is Code; Groups and every other folder behave as before. UI routing only.

src/components/sidebarLeft/tabs/chatFold.reason: Built-in folder subtitle reads FOLDER_ID_GROUPS alongside the folder's own dialogs for folder 0, since Chats excludes groups and the Groups bucket would otherwise always be 0. Display string counts only - no storage, IPC or shape change.

src/components/loadingDialogSkeleton.tsx.reason: Skeleton size union 72 | 64 -> 72 | 64 | 56 so the compact chat list can reuse it. Type-only plus one variant class; no runtime behaviour, storage or IPC change.

src/components/appSelectPeers.ts.reason: Groups (3) enumeration stage added after Archive so the recipient picker keeps offering existing groups (Chats still hides them by presentation rule). Read-only dialog enumeration; no storage or format change.

src/lib/appManagers/appMessagesManager.t.reason: Notify-settings invalidation and folder dialog counting now include the Groups (3) folder. Read-only iteration over existing dialog data; no storage or format change.

src/langPackLocalVersion.example.ts.reason: Local lang-pack version 13 -> 14 so cached clients reload the two new keys. Same constant, same generation flow.

src/lib/folders-sidebar-layout.ts.reason: New module: one writer for the existing settings.tabsInSidebar preference, shared by the hamburger toggle and the rail button. Writes the same key the Chat Folders radio already wrote.

src/components/sidebarLeft/tabs/phantomc.reason: Desktop entry point for the Updates tab is now a re-export of the application tab, so one screen (and one channel control) serves both builds instead of two that could drift. The screen it resolves to is covered by the phantomchatApplicationUpdates.ts approval; this file itself holds no logic and no storage.

src/lib/phantomchat/desktop-update-view..reason: Dependency-free presentation strings only: status line, last-checked line, action button. The two channel-choice helpers moved out to lib/phantomchat/update-channel-choice.ts, which does not exist at stableRef, so the builder can copy them into pinned Stable. No DOM, no Electron, no app singletons, no storage.

src/lib/phantomchat/update-channel-choic.reason: Dependency-free helpers for the single Release channel radio: what it shows, and how one choice is pushed to whichever update surfaces exist (application channel shell and Electron installer ring). No DOM, no Electron import, no app singletons, no storage; the ring/window wiring stays in the copied tab. Deliberately a NEW file absent at stableRef — desktop-update-view.ts exists in Stable and cannot host an export the copied tab needs.

src/components/phantomchat/sessionBadge..reason: New presentation component: a static `#` chip whose visibility comes from the synchronous session index. No storage, network or state mutation.

src/components/sidebarLeft/foldersSideba.reason: Renders the literal `#` glyph in the icon slot when the payload carries one; every other folder keeps the existing icon/emoji path untouched. Presentation only.
Adds an optional `glyph` field to the folder-item payload so Code can draw a literal `#` (the icon font has no hashtag). Presentation type only.

src/components/sidebarLeft/tabs/contacts.reason: Optional init param onPickPeer: when set, a contact click hands the peer to the caller instead of opening a DM. Default behaviour (no param) is unchanged.

src/lib/appManagers/constants.ts.reason: Adds FOLDER_ID_CODE = 4 to the locally-seeded system folders (REAL_FOLDERS + PROTECTED_FOLDERS), so it is re-seeded on every boot like Groups and cannot be deleted. START_LOCAL_ID moves 4 -> 5; persisted custom folders have their localId reassigned at boot (prependFilters strips it), so no index collides.

src/lib/phantomchat/group-store.ts.reason: save/delete/getAll now mirror each record's session tag into the in-memory index (group-tags). No schema, store name, key path or index change: the IDB layout is byte-identical, updateInfo just accepts an optional `tags` field.

src/lib/phantomchat/group-types.ts.reason: Adds optional `tags?: string[]` to GroupRecord and `groupTags?: string[]` to GroupControlPayload. Optional fields only: existing records/payloads parse and merge exactly as before, and the groups CRDT entry IS the record so no version bump is needed.

src/lib/phantomchat/groups-sync-adapter..reason: CRDT apply keeps local tags when the winning remote record has none, so an older client that renames a session cannot strip the tag for everyone. Merge behaviour for every other field is untouched.

src/lib/storages/filtersLocal.ts.reason: buildLocalFilter(FOLDER_ID_CODE) seeds a literal "Code" title with exclude_archived and no peer-class pFlags — membership is the session tag, not a pFlag, so no dialog changes class.
